# Code of conduct for leaders, mentors and volunteers

**nextVillage.community learning programmes**

Everyone who works with learners signs this before starting. It protects children, and it protects you.
Read it with the child safeguarding policy.

## What I promise

1. **I will put children's safety and dignity first.** I treat every child with respect, patience and
   fairness, whatever their age, gender, religion, tribe, disability, family or ability.
2. **I will never harm a child.** I will not hit, threaten, shame, humiliate or exploit any child. I will
   not use language that is abusive, sexual or demeaning.
3. **I will keep contact open.** I will not be alone with a child out of sight of others, online or in
   person. I will not meet a child privately outside the programme. I will not take a child to my home.
4. **I will keep boundaries.** I will not give gifts, money or favours to one child. I will not ask a child
   for favours, work, secrets, photos or personal information. I will not have a romantic or sexual
   relationship with a learner, and I understand a child cannot consent.
5. **I will communicate in the open.** I will contact learners only about the programme, through the
   programme's channels, and with group messages where I can. I will not message individual children
   privately on personal accounts.
6. **I will protect children's privacy.** I will not share a child's name, photo, voice, work or personal
   story outside the programme without the guardian's written permission. I will not photograph children
   for personal use or post them on personal social media.
7. **I will guard accounts and data.** I will not share my login or ask a learner for theirs. I will follow
   the data handling commitment. I will tell the platform team at once if I lose a device or think an
   account was misused.
8. **I will use AI responsibly.** I will not use the platform to produce harmful, hateful or sexual
   content, and I will not let learners do so. I will not enter children's private details into other
   AI tools.
9. **I will not be affected by alcohol, drugs or weapons** while with learners.
10. **I will report concerns.** If I see or suspect harm, I will follow the safeguarding policy and tell the
    child-protection lead the same day. I will report my own mistakes too. I understand that hiding a
    concern is a breach.
11. **I will not take advantage of my role** for money, favours or personal gain, and I will declare any
    conflict of interest.

## What happens if I break this code

I understand that I may be removed from working with learners at once, that the matter may be reported
to the police or other authorities, and that the organization may end my involvement. I understand that
reporting a concern in good faith will never be held against me.

## Declaration

I have read and understood this code of conduct and the child safeguarding policy. I agree to follow
them. I confirm that I have not been found guilty of any offence against a child, and that I have told the
child-protection lead of anything that might affect my suitability to work with children.
